3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: I came to the Grand National Assembly of Sordland to deliver a speech regarding the new Constitution and ask for the support of the Assembly before the upcoming vote.

4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: I walked quickly through the corridors, giving my greetings to people on my way towards the parliamentary hall.

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: When I entered the hall, the Assembly was in complete chaos, with shouting and cursing between the parties. There was a heavy argument about a proposal made by an MP from NFP.

6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: I took my seat inside the special area reserved for the ministers. Gloria was shouting from her seat at the centre of the hall as she hit the gavel three times, with each strike heavier than the one before.

8.speaker: Narrator
8.text: Despite her efforts, the argument continued for a couple of minutes before everybody took back to their seats and finally went quiet.

9.speaker: Gloria Tory
9.text: "Mr. Kibener, next time when I tell you to do so, either take your seat or leave the hall; so we can proceed with the procedures of this Assembly and continue our duties."

10.speaker: Narrator
10.text: Some MP's from the NFP side shouted back at her in protest.

11.speaker: Gloria Tory
11.text: "Honorable ladies and gentlemen, if you allow me to continue..."

12.speaker: Gloria Tory
12.text: "We have the President here with us today. He has asked to give an important announcement."

13.speaker: Narrator
13.text: I saw Kesaro Kibener standing up from his seat and shouting towards the members of the PFJP.

14.speaker: Gloria Tory
14.text: "Mr. Kibener! Calm yourself! Show respect to the procedures of this Assembly!"

18.speaker: Narrator
18.text: I walked to the stand as loud clapping started in the USP's side.

20.speaker: Player
20.text: "The Supreme Court holds too much power..."

21.speaker: Player
21.text: "Our election threshold has harmed our democracy more than anything..."

22.speaker: Player
22.text: "Perhaps it's not expected of me to say this, but the President holds too much authority..."
22.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Default"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_TermLimits_2"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Honorary_Presidents"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Ministers_Default"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == false

24.speaker: Player
24.text: "...Therefore, we propose changes to the Constitution to prepare Sordland for a more democratic era!"

25.speaker: Player
25.text: "We will break the Supreme Court's authority over constitutional changes."

26.speaker: Player
26.text: "We will fix the loopholes that allows the presidents to exercise absolute veto over legislation."

27.speaker: Player
27.text: "We will rebalance the branches of government to ensure a more democratic process."

32.speaker: Narrator
32.text: Loud noises came from USP and NFP seats.

33.speaker: Gloria Tory
33.text: "Mr. President, with all due respect, I believe Sordland is already democratic."

36.speaker: Player
36.text: "Ladies and gentlemen of the Assembly! We must set aside our differences."

37.speaker: Narrator
37.text: I took a breath and continued.

38.speaker: Player
38.text: "It is time to make a new Constitution together!"

39.speaker: Player
39.text: "I ask everyone to think clearly about our current situation. And join us for change."

40.speaker: Player
40.text: "Ladies and Gentlemen, I demand your votes!"

42.speaker: Player
42.text: "I ask everyone to support us in the upcoming vote."

43.speaker: Player
43.text: "Be part of a new era for Sordland. Join us and vote for our proposal."

44.speaker: Player
44.text: "I will address all the problems of the past in my proposal!"

45.speaker: Player
45.text: "USP will change and lead Sordland into the future!"

50.speaker: Narrator
50.text: The Assembly roared with all kinds of different reactions.

52.speaker: Gloria Tory
52.text: "Thank you for the speech, Mr. President."

59.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
59.conditionsRaw: Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Default"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_TermLimits_2"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Honorary_Presidents"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Ministers_Default"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == false

60.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
60.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Default"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_TermLimits_2"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Honorary_Presidents"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Ministers_Default"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == false) == false

61.speaker: Player
61.text: "Our Constitution doesn't adequately define or respect the separation of powers..."
61.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Decrees_Default"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_TermLimits_2"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Honorary_Presidents"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Ministers_Default"] == false  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Law_Impeachment_Removed"] == false) == false

62.speaker: Player
62.text: "Our elected Assembly has always been overshadowed..."

63.speaker: Player
63.text: "We must finally rewrite the Constitution of Soll and break our chains of the past!"

64.speaker: Player
64.text: "I call everyone to stand by us to make historic changes to our Constitution and bring it to the standards of today's world!"

65.speaker: Narrator
65.text: Loud applauses came from PFJP seats.

66.speaker: Narrator
66.text: Applauses came from USP and PFJP seats.

67.speaker: Narrator
67.text: Applauses came from USP and PFJP seats.

71.speaker: Narrator
71.text: Just as I was about to continue speaking, Gloria Tory interrupted me.

72.speaker: Narrator
72.text: I walked back to my seat as many MP's asked to speak. Frens Ricter was among them.

73.speaker: Narrator
73.text: Suddenly Kesaro Kibener started yelling from his seat.

77.speaker: Player
77.text: "Tarquin Soll will answer for the crimes committed during his rule! We will make sure of that!"

81.speaker: Player
81.text: "We will be removing the presidential decrees and leave lawmaking to the Assembly."

84.speaker: Player
84.text: "We both know that our Constitution is flawed."

86.speaker: Gloria Tory
86.text: "Tarquin Soll and his efforts cannot be ignored. We must keep following the path he defined for Sordish people."

87.speaker: Gloria Tory
87.text: "I'm sure the Honorable Members of USP will see that the President is acting rash by allying with the opposition to destroy the culture of Sollism that established Sordland."

88.speaker: Gloria Tory
88.text: "That was the extent of my quick note. Thank you. The President has the floor."

92.speaker: Narrator
92.text: The whole United Sordland Party stood up and started applauding.
92.conditionsRaw: (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Gloria_Convinced"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Convinced"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Speech_PromisedToTrySoll"] == true) == false)

93.speaker: Narrator
93.text: Some applauses came from the PFJP and USP seats. Most of the others started to make loud noises again.
93.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Gloria_Convinced"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Convinced"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Speech_PromisedToTrySoll"] == true) == false)

95.speaker: Frens Ricter
95.text: "I would like to thank Mr. President for his speech. We, the People's Freedom and Justice Party, stand in agreement with the need for a more democratic Constitution."

96.speaker: Frens Ricter
96.text: "I would like to thank the Ladies and Gentlemen of the United Sordland Party for their more open attitude compared to past years."

97.speaker: Frens Ricter
97.text: "As long as Mr. President's words prove not to be just words, we will be behind this much needed movement for change. We welcome this attempt."

98.speaker: Frens Ricter
98.text: "I ask Mr. President to share the final contents of this proposal as soon as possible."

101.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
101.text: <shout>"The President must have lost his mind to cooperate with the likes of you, Mr. Ricter!"</shout>

102.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
102.text: <shout>"You and PFJP are nothing but puppets of western interests!"</shout>

104.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
104.text: "Madame Speaker! I know you are in agreement with me as well. Don't stand idly there while this administration is making deals with snakes and undermine the integrity of Sor-"

105.speaker: Gloria Tory
105.text: "ORDER! Mr. Kibener! How many times do I need to say? You are speaking out of tu-"

110.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
110.text: "The nationalist movement does not agree with your priorities nor the way you're trying to implement them. The National Front Party will not stand with you on your new Constitution."

111.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
111.text: "Let it be known that the NFP's concerns are not included in this so called "democratic" reforms. Thus Mr. President has no right to claim them as such!"

112.speaker: Kesaro Kibener
112.text: "We will stand our ground against any attempt to bring down our established political culture and national values. Thank you."

113.speaker: Narrator
113.text: Gloria gave him a stare. She looked annoyed.

114.speaker: Narrator
114.text: Kesaro went back to his seat but the chaos in the Assembly continued.

117.speaker: Narrator
117.text: I got up from my seat and started my walk towards the exit.

121.speaker: Player
121.text: "I just wanted to thank everybody for their comments."

123.speaker: Player
123.text: "It is you, who shouldn't use the word 'democratic' when you want a more centralized government."

124.speaker: Player
124.text: "We are not specifically cooperating with someone, but everyone. We ask that you also join us."

125.speaker: Player
125.text: "I'm saddened to hear about your opposite stance."

126.speaker: Narrator
126.text: He watched as he slouched on his seat, legs crossed.

127.speaker: Player
127.text: "Do not stand against change! Be a part of it, Mr. Kibener! We can do much more together."

128.speaker: Player
128.text: "Don't you dare stand against us! Otherwise, know that the NFP is guaranteed to be history."

131.speaker: Player
131.text: "I expect your support in the upcoming vote, Mr. Kibener."

132.speaker: Player
132.text: "We will bring change regardless of your support."

135.speaker: Narrator
135.text: Gloria looked at me to see if I'd finished my response.

145.speaker: Player
145.text: "Rest assured, your concerns will be addressed."

147.speaker: Player
147.text: "We'd like to have cooperation between our parties."

150.speaker: Player
150.text: "I expect your support, Mr. Ricter! We can do much more together."

151.speaker: Player
151.text: "Thank you for your support. We are looking forward to work with the PFJP."

153.speaker: Narrator
153.text: Gloria looked at me to see if I'd finished my response.

157.speaker: Narrator
157.text: MP's kept shouting and responding to each other, creating a loud mess where nothing was legible.

158.speaker: Gloria Tory
158.text: "Order! Order! This topic has finished. We are moving unto our next topic..."

159.speaker: Narrator
159.text: I slowly left the hall. Thew shouting could be heard from every corridor of the Grand National Assembly.

160.speaker: Narrator
160.text: I got up from my seat and started my walk towards the exit.

165.speaker: Narrator
165.text: I slowly left the hall. The shouting could be heard from every corridor of the Grand National Assembly.
165.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["BaseGame.Speech_PromisedToTrySoll"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Convinced"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Gloria_Convinced"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Convinced"] == true  and  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Gloria_Convinced"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Convinced"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Gloria_Convinced"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Albin_Convinced"] == true  or  Variable["BaseGame.Reform_Gloria_Convinced"] == true) == false) and (Variable["BaseGame.Wehlen_TradeDeal"] == true) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Wehlen_TradeDeal"] == true) == false)

166.speaker: Player
166.text: "There is a victory growing with every morning..."

168.speaker: Player
168.text: "There is my country beyond everything, my beloved..."

169.speaker: Player
169.text: "There is God beyond existence or nonexistence..."

170.speaker: Player
170.text: "Fear not when the dark falls! There is an artist painting the sun."

171.speaker: Player
171.text: "Beyond the next morning, there is a victory waiting to be won."

172.speaker: Player
172.text: "There is a spring that blossoms out of the graves of our fallen..."

175.speaker: Player
175.text: "Do not dare to surrender! There is a victory that grows with defeat."

176.speaker: Player
176.text: "There are songs to be sung in affectation of our victories..."

178.speaker: Player
178.text: "There is the evil that tortures and tears me down..."

179.speaker: Player
179.text: "Do not doubt the One! There is a decision coming from the heavens..."

237.speaker: Player
237.text: "I'll act as if that didn't happen."

238.speaker: Player
238.text: "Who are you trying to provoke, Mrs. Tory? USP is behind me."

239.speaker: Player
239.text: "That was disrespectful Mrs. Speaker. Please don't try to sabotage my speech."

240.speaker: Player
240.text: "We are not here to destroy Sollism nor our cultural values."

244.speaker: Gloria Tory
244.text: "You've just promised to try Soll, Mr. President! You are talking about the founder of this party. He is the true founder of this republic."

245.speaker: Gloria Tory
245.text: "What crimes are you talking about? You owe everything you have to him. This is unacceptable!"

246.speaker: Narrator
246.text: Loud noises came from USP and NFP seats.

254.speaker: Narrator
254.text: The whole United Sordland Party stood up and started shouting at me.

255.speaker: Gloria Tory
255.text: "Your time is finished. Please take your seat, Mr. President."
